title: PREreview Roundtable “Beyond Visibility: How Do We Make Peer Review Truly Valued?”
what_changed: DORA and PREreview hosted an online roundtable (7 October, 39 participants) on valuing peer review, gathering input for DORA's forthcoming Practical Guide. Discussion centred on recognition and reward mechanisms: financial compensation, targeted support for early-career reviewers, digital certification, and reciprocity and credit systems.
why_it_matters: Peer review work is largely invisible and unrecognised in assessment systems, which shapes the incentives (or lack of them) for doing it and feeds a sustainability crisis; the roundtable output feeds directly into a Guide that scholarly-communication organisations will implement.
